notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.notes:
ADDITIONS / CHANGES


 Added more sound effects (including laser sounds)
 Added a tutorial panel animation (making it more obvious there is a tutorial when loading in)
 Added ruin puzzle hints (some players were getting stuck trying to solve them)
 Improved player movement animation
 Added loading screen tips
 Reworked teleporter triggers (they no longer teleport you back when staying still on them)
 Removed biome sounds and effects while in ruins
 Improved some upgrade icons
 Added fireflies
 Added some holiday cheer to the main menu
 Added a limited-edition holiday accessory
 Added some holiday cheer to dwellers
 Other minor bug fixes


Feel free to contact me in the #voxel-miner channel in our discord server for any support/questions!  Discord Server

notes.title: The STORY Update!
notes.notes:
ADDITIONS / CHANGES


 added XP loot boxes (can be found in ruins like the normal loot boxes)
 added 40 notes that can spawn in ruins (lore! uncover the mysteries of the virus, and why this once flourishing cave has been abandoned, and consumed by a devastating virus)
 added notes menu to the radial menu (here you can view your discovered notes, and read through them)


Feel free to contact me in the #voxel-miner channel in our discord server for any support/questions!  Discord Server

notes.title: Accessories Update
notes.notes:
ADDITIONS / CHANGES


 added a customization menu (replaced the textures button)
 implemented accessories (this will allow you to add accessories to your player!)
 added crown accessory (currently the only one available, more soon to come!)


Im going to be going on vacation for a week, but I am bringing my laptop to continue updates, they might be smaller ones during this period, but I'm back on 6/27.  Feel free to contact me in the #voxel-miner channel in our discord server for any support/questions in the meantime!  Discord Server

notes.title: Community Update
notes.notes:
ADDITIONS / CHANGES


 added news panel
 added credits page (huge thanks to everyones support so far!)
 increased dropoff odds (changed on 6/16)
 added option to lower texture quality (hopefully helps memory issues caused by low ram)
 fixed issues with occasionally dying from teleporting


UPCOMING


 more ruins / dungeons
 more enemies (and possibly adding bosses)
 more upgrades
 more optimizations / graphical improvements


Im going to be going on vacation for a week, but updates will resume once I'm back! (on 6/27)  Feel free to contact me in the #voxel-miner channel in our discord server for any support/questions in the meantime!  Discord Server
